info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking It Management Platform Operations Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking IT Management Platform Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the status of various banking IT operations. This endpoint allows users to monitor the current operational state, ensuring that stakeholders can quickly assess system performance and reliability. Typical consumers include IT administrators and business analysts who need to track operational metrics and ensure seamless services. By leveraging this API, organizations can proactively address potential issues and maintain optimal performance for their banking platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of platform operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current operational status of the IT management platform. It provides real-time updates on the health and performance of various services, helping administrators to quickly identify issues.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving the operational status of the platform. This payload must conform to the specified JSON schema to ensure correct processing by the server.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of platform operations.

_s_it-management_s_platform-operations_s.description: The status request body for platform operations. It represents a string value indicating the status.

ListBankingItManagementPlatformOperation.title: Operations Status Response

maintenanceWindow.description: The scheduled maintenance window for the operation.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the operation status information.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the information was last updated.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A correlation identifier for tracking requests.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the operation occurred.

ListBankingItManagementPlatformOperation.description: Response schema for the operations status endpoint, providing details about the current status of a specific system operation.
